name: email-local-core
description: The portable half of Email Local MCP: the email tool vocabulary (~25 MCP tools), the MailProvider contract, and the host seam. Runs on Node and in a V8 isolate (Cloudflare Workers, Deno) — no IMAP, no filesystem, no credential store.
author: Marcin Walendowski
//peerDependenciesMeta: Optional so a package manager treats these as 'the host must already have them' rather than as a constraint to satisfy. They are hard requirements in practice — the host owns the McpServer instance, so both sides must resolve the SAME copy — but declaring them non-optional made pnpm fold `zod` into one workspace-wide resolution and silently downgrade an unrelated app from zod 4 to zod 3.
